business_summary: Guangzhou Echom Sci. & Tech. Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, production, and sale of structural components in China and internationally. The company offers automotive parts, including traditional interior parts, traditional spray-painted exterior components, cold plates, thermoplastic composite tailgates, front end modules, plastic fenders, and side and trim panels; and energy storage system structural components, such as liquid-cooled and air-cooled energy storage boxes, household stacking boxes, charging piles, energy storage box top covers, liquid cooling plates, and front decorative panels and brackets of storage energy box. It also provides healthcare products comprising reaction cups, deep hole plates, PCR tubes/plates, virus sampling tubes, micropipettes, microcentrifuge tubes, centrifuge tubes, serum pipettes, serum vials, cryopreservation tubes, cell culture plates, cell culture dishes, cell culture flasks, and erlenmeyer flasks; precision molds, which include multi-cavity consumable mold antigen test card bottom covers, automated pipette tips, 96 deep hole plates, immune response cups, and quantitative pipettes; industrial design products; and robot parts. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
